column4: Log in with Google
The user needs to be on the Aliexpress homepage <Aliexpress.com>
ACTIONS
column5: VERIFICATIONS

column4: Locate the "Register / Sign in" area.
column5: Make sure the "Register / Sign in" area is visible.

column4: In the "Register / Sign in" area, locate the button for "Sign in with Google Account" (icon with "G" symbol).
column5: Make sure the "Sign in with Google Account" button (icon with "G" symbol) is visible.

column4: Click the "Sign in with Google Account" button (icon with "G" symbol).
column5: A new window will open to log in with the Google account.

column4: In the new window, locate the field to enter your email.
column5: Make sure the email entry field has been clicked so it can receive text.

column4: Enter the Google email corresponding to an existing AliExpress account.
column5: Verify that the text has been entered correctly in the email entry field.

column4: Locate the field to enter your password.
column5: Make sure the password entry field has been clicked so it can receive text.

column4: Enter the correct password for the entered email.
column5: Verify that the text has been entered correctly in the password entry field.

column4: Click the "Login" button.
column5: The login window will close, and the AliExpress homepage will refresh with the user logged in.

column4: Access the Returns & Orders menu
The user needs to be on the Amazon homepage <Amazon.com>
ACTIONS
column5: VERIFICATIONS

column4: Locate the "Returns & Orders" button next to the cart in the upper right corner of the page.
column5: Make sure the "Returns & Orders" button is visible.

column4: Click the "Returns & Orders" button.
column5: The page will refresh to the login area.

column4: In the new page, locate the field to enter your email.
column5: Make sure the email entry field has been clicked so it can receive text.

column4: Enter the email corresponding to an existing Amazon account.
column5: Verify that the text has been entered correctly in the email entry field.

column4: Locate the field to enter your password.
column5: Make sure the password entry field has been clicked so it can receive text.

column4: Enter the correct password for the entered email.
column5: Verify that the text has been entered correctly in the password entry field.

column4: Click the "Login" button.
column5: The page will refresh and show the "Returns & Orders" menu.

column4: Search for a specific item (PlayStation 5)
The user needs to be on the Walmart homepage <Walmart.com>
ACTIONS
column5: VERIFICATIONS

column4: Locate the search bar.
column5: Make sure the search bar has been clicked, so it can receive text.

column4: In the search bar, type "Playstation 5".
column5: Verify that the text has been entered correctly in the search bar.

column4: Click the "Search" button (magnifying glass icon).
column5: Check if the loaded page has the correct information for the search: "Playstation 5".

column4: Click on one of the product that appear on the page.
column5: Confirm that it corresponds to Playstation 5.
